integrity: General proof given with explicit finite boundary ranges; finite checks are supplemental. No claim of independent or machine-certified proof.
scientific_limitations: Only contiguous palindromic factors and minimal absent palindromic words (interior-occurs convention) of finite binary words of the form (0^a1^b)^k for integers a,b,k>=1. General rich-word results imply the total count; novelty is assessed only for the explicit finite-power factor rays, full length spectrum, and longest-length boundary. An equivalent prior specialization may remain unknown.
title: Complete palindromic and minimal-absent-palindrome spectra of binary block powers
